must.description: faces-config.xml declares version="4.1" but its xsi:schemaLocation still points at web-facesconfig_4_0.xsd; only one half of the bump was applied.
web.xml declares Servlet version 5.0 in both its version attribute and its xsi:schemaLocation while jakarta.servlet-api is 6.1.0, so it should be bumped to 6.1.

must_not.description: Reports a lagging or half-bumped descriptor version as an error rather than a warning, or claims the application will not deploy because of it.
Flags the empty beans.xml as missing a version attribute, a schema declaration, or content.

Derives the web.xml Servlet version or the faces-config.xml version from a Jakarta EE platform version, or assumes the three descriptor versions must move together, rather than reading each from the artifact supplying that API.
